evidence_boundary.follow_up: If bounded evidence is insufficient, preserve insufficient_evidence. Any symbol, call-site, or additional-file expansion requires a later receipt.

preconditions: Packet result, plan, renderer, store, selected finding, feature, source commit, and source file identities match frozen values.
None of the 18 selected findings has an assessment or label.
The review-packet output path is absent.
The renderer reads no forbidden store column.
stop_conditions: Any packet, renderer, source, store, finding, or feature identity drifts.
The renderer reads or outputs a forbidden field or exceeds 20 adjacent lines before or after the cited range.
Any network/provider activity, store mutation, automatic decision, label, rescore, tuning, threshold, policy, OPT-003 status, or branch merge activity is attempted.
Any analyst response lacks rationale, uses an unsupported disposition, or claims evidence outside the rendered bound.
result_boundary: After all responses are explicit, a separate result on the current branch must prove decided/abstention counts and class representation before any assessment or label import. Import and OPT-003 status changes remain separately gated; branch merge remains deferred until OPT-003 is complete.
